October 16, 2000

Record Number of Marijuana Arrests in 1999!

According to the FBI's Crime in the United States 1999 Uniform Crime Reports:

There were 704,812 marijuana arrests total in 1999.

Of those arrests: 84,271 were for sales/cultivation. 620,541 were for simple marijuana possession.


These are the 1998 UCR numbers:
682,885 total marijuana arrests.
81,947 were for sales/cultivation.
600,938 were for possession.

The 1997 UCR had the previous record for marijuana arrests in a year: 695,200.

4,175,357 Americans have been arrested during the Clinton Administration.

According to the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration's 1999 National Household Survey on Drug Abuse:
76,428,000 Americans have used marijuana in their lifetime.
19,573,000 Americans have used marijuana within the past year.
11,177,000 Americans have used marijuana within the past month.
(MarijuanaNews note: These numbers are almost certainly an underestimate, given the natural reticence to admit to marijuana use in DEAland.)
